column1: # Rename map of the port (PROVENANCE.md): old name → new name, one per line, tab-separated.
# A line renames a namespace (and every name in it) or a single name; the longest match wins;
# `-` as the new name marks a declaration removed on purpose; `~` a theorem (renamed by the other
# lines as usual) whose statement is changed on purpose, only by dropping arguments the rest of the
# statement does not use outside proofs, such as an unused hypothesis (the statement check accepted
# nothing else); the new statement implies the old one.
# Used by the statement check up to the toolchain bump to v4.35.0 (PROVENANCE.md, "Toolchain"), and
# to link names to the claim registry. Since that bump statements may change in place: `~` and `-`
# record the port up to it; renames are still recorded here.
